scope: Known frozen-feature classifier-loss baseline; no novel method claim. Full eightfold historical-user readout comparison only.
quality_exclusion: Exclude known duplicate user2 labels10,11 and mismatched user6 label3; 9300 eligible rows.
roles: For held user h, validation is h+1 with 8 wraps to1; train is other six. Use the existing frozen full8 epoch-selected 128-dimensional hidden features. No network training or changes.
feature_preprocessing: Use same hidden representation in all four arms. Fit standardization on train only using either equal-user/equal-present-class sample weights (balanced) or uniform record weights (uniform), according to arm. Intercept unpenalized.
ridge: Weighted least squares on one-hot labels, objective sum_i w_i ||p_i-onehot(y_i)||^2 + lambda/2 ||W||_F^2, unpenalized intercept; w normalized to sum one.
logit: True 12-class multinomial cross entropy, objective sum_i w_i[-log softmax(z_i W+b)_{y_i}] + lambda/2 ||W||_F^2, unpenalized intercept; w normalized to sum one. SciPy L-BFGS-B, require max gradient<2e-7 and convergence.
selection: For each arm independently choose lambda on next validation user by maximum macro accuracy, then minimum MSE of 12 output probabilities against one-hot, then larger lambda. This is a fixed three-value validation family, no held labels.
controls: 2x2 readout baseline: loss (onehot squared error vs multinomial cross entropy) × record weighting (balanced user/class vs uniform). Fixed checkpoint/features and split; uniform-weight arms assess whether balanced weighting explains a loss effect. Also report frozen CNN decisions.
stop: No tuning outside lambda family. Regardless of result, this is a known readout baseline and cannot fulfill the novel contribution goal. Failure closes this fixed logistic-versus-ridge comparison; no eightfold seed/feature/model expansion or alternative-arm promotion.

prior_art.logistic_probe: Kumar et al., Fine-Tuning Can Distort Pretrained Features and Underperform Out-of-Distribution, ICLR 2022, arXiv:2202.10054. Paper uses L2-regularized logistic regression on frozen features and ID validation-selected regularization. General deep-learning prior, not UWB gesture contribution.
prior_art.dataset_and_method: Original project already includes multinomial logistic regression, so no claim of method novelty. This run fills the absent same-checkpoint full-eightfold controlled comparison.
prior_art.implementation: scikit-learn multinomial logistic model/objective docs; custom SciPy implementation independently checked against sklearn Newton-CG.

cost_estimator: Time 1 fixed synthetic 7200x128 weighted multinomial logistic fit; multiply by 48 fits and 2x headroom. No real data read during cost-only.
quality_notes: Historical eight source subjects have been reused; this is not fresh external confirmation.
The held diagnostic labels are loaded only after all eight folds, candidate coefficients, validation scores/selections, and held predictions are persisted.
Known full8 frozen ridge accuracy 94.897727%; evaluate new logistic against it under same fold and checkpoint.
No original-source snapshot changes, raw arrays remain outside Git, report remains a known baseline.
